name: Uberduck
description: Generate text-to-speech audio, list voices, clone voices, and list speech models with the Uberduck API.

authentication.name: API Key
authentication.description: Authenticate with an Uberduck API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.
authentication.notes: Uberduck requires every API request to send the API key as the Authorization bearer token. Native raw-header apiKey auth would not match this wire contract, so this app uses custom auth with one secret source of truth.

credentials.name: API Key

setupGuide.title: Connect Uberduck with an API key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an Uberduck account with API access and an API key generated from your account settings.

steps.title: Open the Uberduck account page
steps.description: Sign in with apps@mindcloud.co or the account that owns the API key, then open https://www.uberduck.ai/app/account.

steps.title: Locate or generate the API key
steps.description: Find the existing key named MindCloud Stage0 2026-04-14, or create a new API key if needed. Copy the full key value exactly once when Uberduck shows it.

steps.title: Paste the key into MindCloud
steps.description: In the MindCloud connection form, paste the key into the API Key field. MindCloud sends it as Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on every request.

name: Unkey
description: Manage API keys, identities, roles, and rate limits

authentication.name: Root Key
authentication.description: Authenticate with an Unkey root key via Authorization bearer auth.
authentication.notes: Use a root key with the least privileges needed for the actions you plan to run. Unkey only shows the full key once after creation.

setupGuide.title: Connect Unkey with a Root Key
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need access to the Unkey dashboard and permission to create root keys for the workspace you want to manage.

steps.title: Open the Root Keys page
steps.description: In the Unkey dashboard, go to Settings and then Root Keys.

steps.title: Create a new root key
steps.description: Click Create New Root Key, enter a clear name for this MindCloud connection, and choose the permissions this connection should have.

steps.title: Copy the key immediately
steps.description: Copy the root key as soon as Unkey shows it, then paste it into the MindCloud Root Key field. Unkey only shows the full key once.

arguments.name: precio1
arguments.description:
Establece el monto a asignar para la primera lista de precio configurada en el sistema.
Se pueden colocar hasta 10 parámetros de precio, ("precio1","precio2","precio3", ...), uno por cada lista de precio configurada en el sistema.
Para determinar que lista de precio corresponde a cada parámetro "PRECIO", es necesario obtener el "indiceLista" de las listas de precio.
 ¿Dónde obtengo el indice de la lista de precio?
El monto de mi lista de precio con "indiceLista": "1" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "precio1".
El monto de mi lista de precio con "indiceLista": "2" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "precio2".
Así sucesivamente.

arguments.name: precio1
arguments.description:
Establece el monto a asignar para la primera lista de precio configurada en el sistema.
Se pueden colocar hasta 10 parámetros de precio, ("precio1","precio2","precio3", ...), uno por cada lista de precio configurada en el sistema.
Para determinar que lista de precio corresponde a cada parámetro "PRECIO", es necesario obtener el "indiceLista" de las listas de precio.
 ¿Dónde obtengo el indice de la lista de precio?
El monto de mi lista de precio con "indiceLista": "1" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "precio1".
El monto de mi lista de precio con "indiceLista": "2" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "precio2".
Así sucesivamente.

El monto de mi comision con "indiceComision": "2" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "comision2".
Así sucesivamente.

arguments.name: impuesto1

Para determinar impuesto corresponde a cada parámetro "impuesto", es necesario obtener el "indiceImpuesto" de los impuestos configurados.
 ¿Dónde obtengo el indice de los impuestos?
El monto de mi impuesto con "indiceImpuesto": "1" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "impuesto1".
El monto de mi impuesto con "indiceImpuesto": "2" , se debe enviar en el parámetro "impuesto2".

name: UseINBOX
description: Email marketing API for managing INBOX campaigns, senders, newsletters, contacts, contact lists, groups, custom fields, and segments.

authentication.name: INBOX Account
authentication.description: Authenticate with an INBOX account email and password. The connector exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token through POST /token.
authentication.notes: INBOX issues bearer tokens from the account email/password flow. The connector exchanges credentials through the Get Token auth action and stores the expiring bearer token in credential.secrets.custom.access_token.

credentials.name: Email Address
credentials.description: INBOX account email address used to request bearer tokens from POST /token.

credentials.name: Password
credentials.description: INBOX account password used to request bearer tokens from POST /token.

setupGuide.title: Connect your INBOX account
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need an active INBOX account email address and password.

steps.title: Enter your INBOX account email address

steps.title: Enter your INBOX account password
steps.description: Use the password for the same INBOX account.

steps.title: Save the connection
steps.description: MindCloud exchanges the email address and password for an INBOX bearer token using the documented token endpoint.

name: Uspacy
description: Manage CRM, tasks, webhooks, and team activity in Uspacy

authentication.name: Workspace JWT
authentication.description: Use your workspace site and a bearer token minted from Uspacy sign-in.

credentials.name: Workspace Site
credentials.description: Your full Uspacy workspace host, for example acme.uspacy.com.

credentials.name: JWT Token
credentials.description: Bearer JWT access token returned by the documented Uspacy sign-in flow.

credentials.name: Refresh Token
credentials.description: Refresh token returned by Uspacy sign-in; store it for later manual refresh.

setupGuide.title: Set up your Uspacy workspace token
setupGuide.beforeYouBegin: You need your Uspacy workspace URL, the workspace login email, and the workspace password.

steps.title: Find your workspace site
steps.description: Copy the host part of your Uspacy workspace URL, for example acme.uspacy.com.

steps.title: Generate a JWT token
steps.description: Send a POST request to /auth/v1/auth/sign_in on your Uspacy workspace with your email and password. If your workspace asks for a second-factor code, include code in the request body.

steps.title: Fill the connection fields
steps.description: Enter your workspace host in Workspace Site, paste jwt into JWT Token, and optionally paste refreshToken into Refresh Token.

steps.title: Refresh the token when needed
steps.description: Send a POST request to /auth/v1/auth/refresh_token with the refresh token, not the access token, in the Authorization header.
